name: Carter County, TN
findings: Carter County has 95 nonprofit organizations. 31 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 25 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Carter County has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
39% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Carter County list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 55% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 29 organizations here; 57% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Carter County list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 63% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 40 organizations here; 57% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Few religious organizations list membership
observations.text: No religious organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 6 would.

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 57% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through religious groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 8 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 57% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?
